t: Meet Grooden Dubin in Upper City.

So the veil has been installed. Now nothing can leave or enter Umoir. I control most portals, so the problem of spreading the Leper is solved now, I guess.

One of my old partners might have an idea of how to fight the Leper now. His name’s Grooden, he used to be one of the strongest mages in Umoir. He trusted in the Light, and abdicated the pagan beliefs, this is why he stayed intact, when the Leper came... The others weren’t so lucky. Only the Light is able to withstand the Leper!
I gather you’re the new watchdog of the Queen? She’s capable of selecting decent servants!
Teleport to the Guardian Ring and defeat the corrupted Keepers.
Stop, friend! Be not in a hurry! Don’t spot your hands with the innocents’ blood! Listen to what I say first.
Velerad Oak is my name. I used to be the Head of the Guardian Ring once, now I sadly observe what the Leper has done to us. Even to me, as a matter of fact...
Gather dust and use it on the Corrupted.

Was it Grooden who sent you to finish with us? My own brother turned out to be such a snake, who could have though. Traitor!

He escaped, and took one magic thing with him. I will never forgive him for it. Without this thing, our protection weakened, and the Leper came in our Ring. My other brothers became corrupted. But I still hope to return human form to them. Only I can’t see the way how to do it...

I have an idea. We have to calm them down for a while. Bring me some pollen of local flowers. We let them sniff it, it will send them to sleep.
Don't be long! The Leper goes deeper into the bodies with every second! It might turn inconvertible!
Here's the pollen. The Leper is pityless even to iridiens. I remember how beautiful they were...
Calm down 15 Corrupted Druids near the Ring of Balance, then return to Velerad Oak.

I cast a spell on this corrupted pollen. Anyone who sniffs it, will become weak and sleepy. The only problem is how to make someone actually sniff it?.. Maybe they will become weak after a fight and easier to deal with.

Don’t overdo it, however. We have enough dead brothers already.
Enough with blood and deaths. The Ring has lost many!
Nice. Now that they’re quiet, their sense will come back into them easier.
Bring 6 Galactic Deer’s horns, 10 Taksa’s hearts and 10 Toad’s eyes to Velerad Oak.

Thank gods, we can have at least temporary rest from the Leper. Now we need to get into the Ring, I only wish we could go past the Leper. Can you feel the stinking breath? It’s the Tree, possessed by the disease...

I can think of only one way. Animals, possessed by the Leper, can enter the Ring freely. It might be because of the corrupted blood. See my point?
Don’t say anything. Death of any living being, even a corruped one, makes me deeply sad. These creatures used to be peaceful and normal back in the past...
Their flesh and blood might store the memory of the normal life!

When the corrupted will be dazing, Velerad will ask the player to get inside the central tree. However, corruption inside the trunk is so severe, that noone can stay there long enough. Velerad suggests using the corrupted animals to overcome the corruption. Player's task is to obtain the necessary parts of the animals and bring them to the druid.
Take Velerad to the Ring of Balance to the tree and protect him, while he cleans out the Leper inside the Ring.

Let’s risk what’s worth it!

I am going in the middle of the Guardian Ring, inside the sacred tree, and clean out or at least restrict the Leper inside of it. Forces of Nature and gods will help me! And you will guard and protect me!
Explore Umoir and find the direction of the Leper spreading, then return to Velerad Oak in the Guardian Ring.

This is miracle! Thoughts and dreams come true!

The Leper hid. I cannot defeat it. I don’t even know where it has come from, and why. Please, help me again!

I can see you are touched by the Leper. It means you can see some manifestations that is invisible to the normal eye. Find the source of this disease. Maybe then we’ll have a chance...
It’s moving toward the center, to Upper and Lower Cities. Or is it the center that it’s spreading from?.. Only the capital stays intact, I wonder why.
Catch a living hampster, collect 5 bright flowers and 35 forest nuts, and bring all this to Milonega to the Guardian Ring.

I wish I died, only not to see how the Leper ruined the forest, and trees, and flowers, and beasts...

I still have hope that there is something that has stayed intact. Please, find some normal seeds and flowers, so that we could grow them here, again. And I'd like to have a normal pet, small and fluffy, just for a company...
The Ring of Balance used to be full of life and fun, and now it’s only a shadow...
See the John’s visions and defeat them.

Whispers, voices... can you hear them? Can you see this? Can you feel?..

Do you want to see their eternal beauty? Hear their most beautiful voices?.. Say you do! Help me, share it with me!..

What’s going on? My visions have become true?!

You’re not a common human, as I can see. No common beings can create things out of thin air and Astral! It may be only one thing.

Yes. It’s the Leper that grants unusual powers... May the gods protect us...
Ask Goldie Nickel about the living gems.

I guess Catherina profits from the Leper. Everything is in her power now. She cuts down the forests as if to get rid from the Leper - and uses wood to build ships! She would never have dared to touch our sacred trees and destroy our idold, before the Leper came...

Oh, how I would love to take a look at whole Umoir, see what goes on in every corner of it... I once was able to do so, you know. I used living gems for it, they were really good. One trader gave them to me as a reward for something I had done for him. The Leper killed them, turned them into pieces of useless glass, and I don’t know where to find the likes.

You may talk to the trader, his name’s Goldie Nickel and he lives in Upper City. If you bring me the gems, we’ll have a good key to understanding the Leper.
I’ll do my best to help you.
That’s that. I cannot help you, I am sorry. The mine doesn’t belong to me any more.
Meet Jade Gloom in Upper City.

I used to have a mine, true. I don’t own it any more. My brother Nickel gave me advice - trade the spices from the overseas. Buy a whole ship there, sell them here. That sounded reasonable, for since the traders were banned, we don’t have much spice to use here.

The price for the spices was high. I was completely taken in by them, borrowed a lot of money, and bought a whole ship of it. I even had to mortgage my gem mine, you know. Of course, mea culpa, I should have analysed the situation first - now the templars speak against the spice, for it’s not good about the Light, and kind of prohibited. So I’ve stayed here for a while, unable to sell anything. It smells nice, but people wouldn’t buy it! I’m desperate, my debt is outdated, and the mine is no longer mine, pardon my pun. It belongs to Jade Gloom now, he’s the master of gems and jewels, and I don’t own but tears and bitterness...
Convince Grub to share trophies with Jade

Oh, that's what you're asking for then, eh? As if I made Goldie run into debt! He came to me himself, and he himself offered me the conditions! He promised to give his mine to me, unless he pays off all that he borrowed! I didn't make him, you know. So we signed the papers, and it wasn't my fault that he didn't make it with the trade.
Tit for tat, you say? That works for me, and I do have a favor to ask for, indeed. There's this bridge, see, crossed by pretty many people. And there's a troll who lives under this bridge and collects fee from everyone who crosses the bridge. So I thought, why would a troll need so much money? Why doesn't he share it?
Go tell him he ought to share, you know, to secure his precious bridge from being washed down with the high water, or anything worse. Do you know what I mean? As soon as you persuade the troll, go and see Nickel. He's in.
You normally don’t expect gold to flow in your pockets by itself.

Now you've got the idea of one in the hand against two on a tree?

My elder brother still weeps about the mine? That's stupid enough. I only inherited an old jacket and a worn hat! What’s so fair about it? So I played a trick with the spice - made him buy a lot, and then made the templars prohibit it, deed's done, I get the mine! Justice on the move!

I owe Jade now, but that's nothing. I help you - I pay off half the debt!

One gem saved Nickel’s life, another gem took it away. It’ll serve you now.

Go to Velerad and give him the Prophetic Ruby. If it helps get rid of the Leper, it’s worth it!
Have you found the precious gem?
This is miracle! Your ruby is bigger than the previous one! It’s bound to work better.
Look into the ruby and see the future.

The living gem, called Prophetic Ruby, conceals huge power. If it likes you, it may show you the future, and it will depend only on you how it will actually turn round.

Only remember, that you won’t have a choice - you will only see whatever the gem will show you. Obey its will...

Here's what I'm thinking. All our gods became gods through faith. Don't you know? The Warrior, the Hunter, the Master, the Maiden, even the Sage - they all used to be common people, who returned after death, because people believed in them!
Meet Tale Teller in Lower City’s tavern.

The power is in faith! All of us, who believe in the Light, know this. Tale Teller brings people the word of gods and makes them believe!

Find Tale Teller and ask for his advice!
You again! What would you like to know this time?

Truly amazing things you saw! Sarn and Nihaz... No, I never heard these names before. You say, they are the gods who created our world? Never heard of them, I tell thee.

Don’t be upset. Visions are nothing more than just visions. There were no such gods here. No Sarn, no Nihaz, no Tensess, only emptiness, deep black Nothingness looked me in the eye.

The only thing is quite clear: either to start or to stop the Leper can only a god, and nobody else. To tell you the truth, I thought it was Catherina at first, but no, she’s unable to.

Why would gods get angry with us? Why punish? What are our sins?..
h: Tell about your visions of the future

t:
White lake lies to the east of the city. This place is clear from the Leper, because Gamayun, the prophetic bird, lives there. She’s the child of gods, and she has all the power that gods have. She can give a reply to nearly all questions!

I hope she can help. It is not easy to get to the White lake, but I still hope you can make it.

Go there and find Gamayun. Ask for her advice.
Greetings, hero! What do you seek here?
You’ve come here by a trick! And you’ve brought the Leper inside your body! What have you done?!
Find those who killed the sentries in White lake.

So the sentries have been totally eliminated, eh? They haven’t expected a sudden attack, and a few crossbow bolts were shot into each of them.

Those are not just some bolts - they are real heavy war bolts...

I wonder who that was!
Halt! Hands in the air! Slowly! You move - I’ll shoot!
Activate the beacon, which is hidden near White Lake, meet the Imperial courier and report to Danila Martyn.

I think I’ve seen you before. You’re the legend, do you know that? Your story is taught in schools! Another secret mission here, eh?

We’re not beating about the bush here, you know. We’re sabotaging the League! Yes, we are! Remember the Kanian rebellion? That’s that. Only the Leper is messing with our plans. So now we’re gathering info for the eggheaded researchers, you know.

One of our couriers had to arrive, but there are lots of Catherina’s soldiers around the spot. We laid down a couple dozens, but they might return.

Go to the meeting place, activate the beacon and get the message. You are out of suspicion.

Oh, damn... Militia showed up, which means the messenger spilled the beans. But there were no eye witnesses, so I think we'll be fine. No one will hear anything, I promise you.

So here’s the deal. You may find it useful. When we set up here, we came across an old grave. Our scouts reported that there’s an old demon buried in it. The very same demon that defeated your Skrakan! So, they found the entrance to the mound wide open, and tracks all around. Footprints of really big feet!

We didn’t go in. Why would we? I’m sure these tracks belonged to them iron knights. Who could send them there? Catherina.

What does the Queen want with the mound? I'm sure she's not trying to build a wine cellar there.

We didn’t give it much thought, you know. We aren't paid to do so. We'll finish our job, find that traitor and deal with him. Then we'll see. Bye.
Activate the beacon, which is hidden near White Lake, meet the Imperial courier and report to Danila Martyn.

I think I’ve seen you before. You’re the legend, do you know that? Your story is taught in schools! Another secret mission here, eh?

We’re not beating about the bush here, you know. We’re setting up links with Catherina. But she doesn’t seem to be loyal to the Leage. She only wants more power, that’s it.

We have a secret mission here. I won’t tell you what it is, you have to understand. But I will still ask you to help.

One of our couriers had to arrive, but there are lots of Catherina’s soldiers around the spot. We laid down a couple dozens, but they might return.

Go to the meeting place, activate the beacon and get the message. You are out of suspicion.

Wha-at? Guards came instead of the courier? You must be kidding me! Look me in the eye!

You’re not lying then, eh? I can tell by the eyes. So our courier got converted, gave us all out, eh? Just you wait, if Catherina hasn’t got him yet, we will surely dig him under ground ourselves!

As to you... Oh screw, we Imperials are loyal to our word, no matter what. Listen up.

When we set up here, we came across an old grave. Our scouts reported that there’s an old demon buried in it. The very same demon that defeated your Skrakan! So, they found the entrance to the grave wide open, and tracks all around - traces of real big feet!

We didn’t go in. Why should we? I’m sure these tracks belonged to them iron knights. Who sent them there? Your guess? Could it be Catherina, eh?

What would the Queen look for in the grave? She wants to set up no wine cellar there, for sure?

Don’t talk too much, though. You’ll be risking your life if you do. You never saw us, we never saw you. I promise to shoot you, if I ever meet you again.
Kill 10 haregons around White Lake and return to Gamayun.
Don’t you understand that it’s impossible to cure the Leper, only to hide from it? I hid White Lake, concealed it! And then you came and brought in the disease. I can’t help you now.
The Leper is like flood - starts with a drip drop and then it breaks through and sinks everything.

I managed to defeat the initial manifestations, but it’s only for the time being. White Lake is doomed. I only have one hope that you who brought in the evil, will help.

Ancient gods get weaker. The Leper and the Light suck their power. We have very little time left.
Acquire the sacrificial bird, fish, beast and flower and place them on the altar.

It’s easy to call upon gods, but will they reply? Faith feed them, but faith may kill them as well. Catherina is killing our father’s faith, making ancient gods weaker and weaker.

But it’s no use crying. If you want to talk to the gods, you have to bring them sacrificial gifts: one for the warrior, one for the hunter, for the master and the virgin. Place them on the altar and ask your question. They might answer.

I am no helper to you any more.
We wish we could tell you more, but something is not revealed to us...
Your call was very clear and loud. Here we are.
Talk to Umoir gods and report to Catherina in Skytower.

May the good be with you, stranger! We are not fond of the unwise sorceress that you server, but I do not observe evil in your heart, only the power - which is not yours, but granted to you. Not gold and riches, but only the truth and faith prevail! The magic and tricks do not last long!

Whatever you had chosen, was granted to you. It is your fate, your decision.

What would you like to hear?
Where have you been so long? All my servants are turning Upper City inside out looking for you!
That’s a surprise. Where have you found this feather? It’s radiating power I have never met before.
Kill the angry pikes and Fairy Pike, and return to Radunia.

Oh! What a misfortune! I was a young girl and going to marry a young boy in our village, when I was forced to get married to the Sea king. But it’s not that bad.

The Sea king was angry and cruel. He used to beat his servants, and drown boats. So the human marines dragged him out and cooked, so I stayed a lonely and happy widow.

I ran away from the sea palace an settled down here, in White Lake. It was so quiet and beautiful...

...before this all began. Then the pikes in the lakes went mad. They bite and hit with their tails! And their biggest one, Fairy Pike, is completely crazy. She’s always trying to eat me whole! And she speaks about some Yemel. I have no idea who it is, but the pikes really annoy me!
How’s it going with the pikes?
So the death wish of the Fairy Pike didn’t come true? I’m not surprised!
Kill Blueclaw and return the stolen ribbon to Zaryona.

Weep... I lost my magic ribbon, enchanted with true love.

A young guy called Ratemir fell in love with me. He followed me and secretly admired me. It would be dishonor to reveal himself, so I didn’t show I took notice of him, either.

Only once he came out to tell me how much he loved me, and gave me this ribbon. The next day he fell in battle, only this ribbon remained. And now I’ve lost it!

I was a fool! I only wanted to feed a squirrel, and it turned out to be corrupted! It showed me its teeth, and was going to bite off my arm, so I ran! And I think I might have dropped my ribbon there...
I had never thought before that two different creatures, like us, could really fall in love... Now see how it turned out! We only spent one day together.

My magic ribbon! I’ll never lose it again!

You are so brave and strong! I don’t even know how to thank you enough.
Collect 10 Lotus and bring them to Gamayun.

Have you ever heard about forest spirits, stranger? I bet you have, and it was all about evil. Don’t believe that. We’re only evil, if you bring us harm.

That used to be this until now. When the Leper came, my sisters went out of their minds. They ruin the forest, scare people, shoo the animals... It’s strange, because we are magic creatures, which means we cannot be corrupted in any way.

I guess this disease may be cured by Lotus herb. I’m only too scared to go out - what if this disease gets me? May I ask for your help?

Collect ten Lotus herbs and bring them to Gamayun, she knows just what to do.
Jivinka is worried about her sisters? She has a kind heart. We must help her.
Lotus herb is able to expel any kind of sickness from the body. It’s just that the Leper is not a sickness, and Lotus can do nothing about it. But at least, it will bring relief to spiritwoods...
Use Lotus herb to cure 10 Sick Spiritwoods near White Lake, then return to Jivinka.

I will entwine a Lotus wreath and enchant it with my powers. Put it on the head of a forest spirit, and the corruption will leave it at once. As it does, the forest spirit will turn into an awful monster! Don’t be scared! Hit it hard!

Remember, a spiritwood won’t just let you put a wreath on its head. You have to exhaust her first. Make sure not to kill them - they’re good and innocent creatures, it’s the Leper that does the bad.
I’ve heard moans and mortal cries... Do you really want to kill all of my sisters?..
Oh, those were moans and cries of the corrupted beasts! Thank goodness, my sisters are alright! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
Kill 10 Werefoxes and 10 Mad Foxes in White Lake and return to Zaryona.

As I was looking for my ribbon, I saw a mad fox that tried to bite me. Glaring eyes, frazzled fur, bare teeth, so scary! I tried to help it, but it died in an hour. Then I saw another, and another... It seems weird, so many mad foxes at once...

I came to look for the cause of it, and I came across... I’m not sure what. Half human, half fox, it attacked me! I ran away. I think it was a werefox, like a werewolf, only a fox. And it’s bringing so much harm! I wish I could kill it myself!
White Lake is a disaster. I only hope it will all turn out fine...
I’m so sorry to kill the innocent animals, but it’s the thing we have to do!
Meet with Elizaveta Rysina at Yasker's Tower.

Let me think...

I’ve never seen anything like this before. If the Servant of the Light is interfering with the deeds of mortals, it means the balance is tipped. The Leper, the whole nation from the distant past, something is definitely going on!

I guess we have to communicate to the Imperial templars. This vixen Rysina is still gripping hold of the Trinity Church? Go to Nezebgrad and tell her about your fight with the Servant of the Light. Maybe she knows something. Any piece of information is priceless in this situation!
Dare I ask you where you’ve been? Yasker is expecting update on search for Klavdia, and his patience is running out.
Meet Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

Let me think...

I’ve never seen anything like this before. If the Servant of the Light is interfering with the deeds of mortals, it means the balance is tipped. The Leper, the whole nation from the distant past, something is definitely going on!

Whether we want it or not, we’ll have to talk to the League church. If I remember correctly, Marianne de Ardeur is heading the church at the moment? It’s for the better, she knows the past better than the present, she might think of similar cases in the history. Go to Novograd and ask her about the Light.
What? News from Umoir? Spit it out!

Have you any idea what the veil of Mystery is? It cuts Umoir off the world completely - Catherina controls all portals now! She may fully prohibit any entrance! We were planning things on it, planted spies there... Umoir used to be a great destabilizing factor for League’s politics, now it’s all gone.

I guess, none of it is your business. As to the servant of the Light, I don’t know about his powers or where he had come from. He’s never talked to the dead, and the only evidence of his appearance is your words. Remember the Cradle? It’s the only time that the servant of the Light interfered into Sarnaut’s affairs. And I’ve never heard about him attacking mortals.

Something weird is going on. I’ll look for more information, while you visit Yasker and report to him. Be prepared, he’s not in a good mood today.
I’ve been waiting for you for... nevermind, just tell me what you’ve got.

The servant of the Light attacked you, and you not only managed to survive, but drove him back to the Purgatory? It’s unbelievable. It’s the second time that the servant comes to our world. The first appearance was at Cradle Isle, and you was involved both times! Weird coincidence, huh?

There is also Klavdia Kalugina. We still have no idea who she really is, and what she seeks. This story began long ago, back at Gipat shard, where she’s coming from. Daughter of Nihaz captured Tep’s spark... This is not good that she managed to escape, but you were smart enough not to try and stop her. Otherwise I wouldn’t have been talking to you right now.

I’m also worried about the eagerness of Catherina’s forcing the belief in the Light... Our Church may be strict and severe, but not that much. I’m sure every faith may live in peace with any other faith.

You know what, go to Aidenus now, he’s been waiting for you. I will browse through my books and look for any information about the servant of the Light at all.
There you are. I’ve been expecting you long ago. I’m sure you’ve got a good reason to be this late, haven’t you?
Deliver Yasker’s message to Catherina’s Skytower.

You do have a reason to be late. The Leper, the Light, all that... I wonder what binds it all together... Could it be you? See, it all started as soon as you appeared. I know, I know, you mean good for the Empire. Be careful next time, that’s an order!

I admit, I was considering military intrusion to Umoir. This is not a valid option any longer. So, what we’re left with, is diplomacy, including manipulations. Catherina is trying to seize the power, so we’ll try and cut her off the League!

I’ll write her a letter and propose cooperation on the basis of trust and equal rights, independence and Imperial scientific assistance in fighting the Leper. This is a generous offer, so I don’t think she’ll pass on it. But if she does, you may act on your own accord, as you see fit. Don’t let us down!

A letter from Yasker? How interesting. Let’s see what the mighty leader of the Empire is writing... Equalty, acknowledgment, blah blah blah... Nonsense. I am no fool and I am aware that the Imperial so-called independence spreads as far as to permit you select the color of your pants for Nezeb’s anniversary event.

No way. I can stand alone. I’ve found the way to cure the Leper. Have you managed to find out anything about the Servant of Light? He worries me most...
Deliver the message from Aidenus to Catherina in Skytower.

This is sad and frightful news. After Skrakan’s death Umoir tended to radicalism, but I never thought that Catherina was the one to blame. I was wrong. She’s so full of herself, she fancies she’s free to do anything she wants! It’s a disgrace to a great mage!

However, her ambitions don’t bother me much. The Leper troubles me more. We need to study it and learn who stands behind it, whose evil will it is!

Here, this is a letter to Catherina. I’m asking her to withdraw from taking any premature decisions, like wrapping the whole sector into Veil of Mystery. League will help her fight the trouble.

Aha, a message from Aidenus. I won’t even slit it open. I know well enough what he’s saying. That’s "change your mind! think twice! obey!" No way. I can stand alone. I’ve found the way to cure the Leper. Have you managed to find out anything about the Servant of Light? He worries me most.
Search for the trace of Klavdia Kalugina at pirate base in Jolly Roger bay.

As soon as we approach the shore, listen to what I say. If I say, drop face down to dirt - you must drop with your face down into dirt. I say, jump into the Astral - take a breath and jump! Feint the Greedy died a long ago, but his ghost is still there, and he’s still killing people.

We, gentlemen of fortune, rarely trust one another, that’s true. But you can trust me! No son of Octulhu could double cross old Silberpod so far!
What an adventure, I'll be damned! Ah, but I've seen worse. Can tell you some time later... if you survive.
Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

Hold on a minute. A suspiciously looking guy left a note for you. Here’s what it says: "Where are you hiding, buddy? If you want to go on with our little business, meet me in Takalik Harbor". Signed, "E.Silberpod". I’ve no idea who he is, but if I were you, I’d report this immediately!
Here you are! I thought you were a coward! I was wrong, don’t be mad!
Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

Hold on a minute. A suspiciously looking guy left a note for you. Here’s what it says: "Where are you hiding, buddy? If you want to go on with our little business, meet me in Takalik Harbor". Signed, "E.Silberpod". I’ve no idea who he is, but if I were you, I’d report this immediately!
Here you are! I thought you were a coward! I was wrong, don’t be mad!

Who is this wizard?.. Oh wait, I think it might just be boyar Jeer Catherina was talking about. If it is so, the matter is not so simple. Nawlad Jeer is evil. He drove so many people to grave... and he prefers the dead to the living!

He has lived in his mansion for many years now, doesn’t talk to anyone, never goes to the capital, and those who tried to sneak into his house, didn’t return... You have Catherina’s knight with you, so Jeer will have to let you in. But I’m not sure if he agrees to help...

I will show you the way to his allod, but you will have to act on your own accord, once you arrive.

Why are you still in Upper City? Are you scared to go out? Aren't you scared of me, great mage and Queen of Umoir, then? The Leper won't care about your fears, it'll eat you alive. Go now. You need this as well as we do.

Tell me everything! Has he taught you his wisdom? He has? Good I didn't do harm to him... I don't need his knowledge myself, I know all I need to know in necromancy. Now it's high time you apply your knowledge to practice.
Go to Drowsy Woods together with Yelisseus to save his beloved Annette de Tristesse.

My Annette! She’s alive! I nearly abandoned hope!

I will save her, whatever it’s worth! Annette! She is... you have no idea how beautiful she is! She’s all my live, my soul, my love! No reason for living without her!

You will help me, will you not? We have to go to Drowsy Woods and take her home. I’m afraid, whatever drove Ademar crazy, is able to do the same to her. We have to hurry! I will owe you my life, if you help me, I swear!
Where’s Yelisseus? Has something bad happened?

Oh goodie, goodie, my Yelisseus has gone missing! I knew it, I knew no good will be of human’s love to an elf! He wouldn’t listen to me!

Why, oh why has he become a servant to a vampire? Oh Yelisseus... Woe to me! He once told me that if anything bad would happen to him, we have to search for the truth in Kurgan.

You know what? As long as it’s your fault, go directly to the Queen, plead her, beg her to save my Yelisseus from the vampire! She deserves to be killed at the spot, but no, you had to pity her! Now we only have the Queen to hope for...

Oh well well well. Return of the prodigal hero. Why are you doing all this behind my back? Deceiving my servants, exploiting my stuff? I could well understand, if it were for the good! But no. I’ve got plans for Yelisseus, mind you. He’s a loyal noble Kanian. What am I going to do now? Gubarevskies are fools, Zaleskies are not noble enough...

To put it straight: I’m not sending a ship for Yelisseus, I’m sure it’s too late anyway. And if I ever catch you making a mess of my shipyard, I will feed you to a dragon!
Find Firebird in Zalesky Posad and bring it to Catherina.

Listen. There were three brothers, I’m the elder, Vassily is the middle, and Ivan is the little brother - wind in his head! So one night our father ordered us to guard his field. In the middle of the night, fancy that, in the dark and cold! I know, right? Vassily and I, we took no notice and went to bed. What about our little fool Ivan? He spent three nights in the middle of the field, froze his ears off, underslept, underate... my guess is that he started hallucinating. He says he saw a Firebird who ruined our dad’s field, believe it or not. As if there was anything to ruin at all...

So, our father went crazy, said, I want this bird, go and bring it to me, or I’ll cut you off the heritage. We decided it was the little one’s problem, and he was to go for it. He gathered his things, received our father’s blessing and left for Zalesky Posad. A week later, he was back, barefeet, no money, no bag, no pants even! All he was going about, were horses and women - my guess is that he blew all money on races and girls. Father sent him off to Kania, out of harm’s way, out of sight, out of mind.

So if you want to go looking for the bird, try Zalesky Posad first. Watch out, though, not to lose your pants, huh huh.

I wonder how anything like Firebird appeared in our world... I guess it’s coming directly from the ancient times - there was a way more power in the world in those days, and less people to possess it...

So strong and so beautiful! Let’s see if it’s capable of lifting the Leper curse...

The Gubarevskies turned out to be traitors? Damn it... There is nobody I can trust... They died? It’s their own fault, I’m sure.
Meet Xasian Pinov at sawmill near Lower City.

It’s been trouble! Someone sneaked on to the dock and damaged Eclipse! There’s a huge hole in its board, big enough for a horse to come through. If the Queen finds out, I’m dead.

I sent for wooden planks to the lumbermill, but it’s taking them too long, and I don’t know why.

You are my only hope! You’re a stranger here, so you will hardly run off to report to the Queen. Please, be so kind, send my workers back from the sawmill! Help me out!
Let me take a good look at you. Who are you, after all?
Ask Ademar de Tristesse about the sabotage.

It’s good their leader was taken alive. He was about to escaped, but my club caught up with him! See, there he is, blubbering nonsense. I guess my club hit him on the head hard enough.

You may ask him a couple of questions, if you like. Meanwhile, I’ll give orders concerning planks for repairment works.
You’re evil! Go away! You cannot defeat me! I’ll kill you!
Tell what Ademar told you in Upper City.

Eclipse! Eclipse! The end is near! The end is coming!

I told them, but noone would listen! Only Annette did. Now we ruined ourselves, we ruined the world!

The mirror... I shouldn’t have brought it here, to Drowsy Woods... Madness is hidden inside, now everyone will die, and Annette, and Yelisseus, what have we done...

Eclipse will ruin us all! I am already dead...
What are you saying? You saw Ademar! He’s the father of my beloved Annette! What happened to her? Where is she?
Defeat 6 saboteur elves at the lumbermill and return to Xasian Pinov.

So you’re from Maxim, he’s worried about his ship? Do you know we were nearly killed? By who? By elves, of course.

The damned elves won’t let us work! Jumped out of the blue, started setting their orders here! Blood was about to spill. They say, they won’t let a single wood plank leave this place, or else! Guards are too scared to oppose them, so what are we gotta do?

Do you serve the Queen? Talk to these bandits, before they burn down my sawmill!
Never trusted them. We were right to kick them out of Umoir.
That was cool. You should have tried persuading them first, not to start with mincing them! On the other hand, that’ll teach them!

I’ve got two things to tell you - the good one and the bad one. The good one is that I know where Klavdia Kalugina is. The bad one is that we failed to calm her down.

I don’t know what she is, but she’s got Tep’s Spark, the greatest evil-doer of Sarnaut! This is huge power, and I’m not sure it will be used for the good. We know nothing about this "Klavdia", apart from that she’s really unpredictable and dangerous, just like the Director.
Good. Now you will have to act on your own again.

I’ve got two things to tell you - the good one and the bad one. The good one is that I know where Klavdia Kalugina is. The bad one is that we failed to calm her down.

I don’t know what she is, but she’s got Tep’s Spark, the greatest evil-doer of Sarnaut! This is huge power, and I’m not sure it will be used for the good. We know nothing about this "Klavdia", apart from that she’s really unpredictable and dangerous, just like the Director.
Nothing of what you’re about to hear must escape from these walls. Unfortunately, you will have to count upon yourself, but I can help you a little.
Talk to Alexandra Soldina at the port.

I don’t give your abilities a doubt! I’m sure you alone will do better than a whole squad. Your task is to get on the pirates’ allod and find out what Klavdia looks for there. She’s too dangerous to let her interfere into Imperial business!

Alexandra Soldina is waiting for you at the Astral academy. She has some contacts among the pirates.
Greetings! I’ve been waiting for you!
Meet Vlastemir Naimitov in Novograd Astral Academy.

Oh, Klavdia, Klavdia, what are you plotting... Whatever it is, I’m afraid it’s not for the good. Listen, if you ever have this opportunity, do your best to neutralize her. An extremely strong crazy sorceress is capable of destroying whole Sarnaut! First you have to track her down, of course. This is not an easy task!

I don’t think that the pirate base is a good place to start an attack. The pirates will flee as soon as they notice our sails. We have to be more accurate in planning. Vlastemir Naimitov dealt with the pirates before, I think, he can give us good advice.
You say, you need my help? I’ll do my best, but I am not a captain. I know someone, though.
Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

I don’t know much about Astral navigation - unlike my buddy, who’s on friendly terms with the pirates, although he himself has been out of business. He’s in the trade now, and my guess is that it’s not at all legal. His name’s Eugene Silberpod, and he’s one of a kind! You can find him in Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Pass him a message that he still owes me!
Is that a customer? What would you like? Anything to your choice! Absolutely anything! Even if it’s a little illegal.
Meet Eugene Silberpod in Takalik Harbor.

I don’t know much about Astral navigation - unlike my buddy, who’s on friendly terms with the pirates, although he himself has been out of business. He’s in the trade now, and my guess is that it’s not at all legal. His name’s Eugene Silberpod, and he’s one of a kind! You can find him in Takalik Harbor on Eljune. Pass him a message that he still owes Vlastemir - me, that is!
Is that a customer? What would you like? Anything to your choice! Absolutely anything! Even if it’s a little illegal.
Capture the pirate ship, docked to the South of Takalik Harbor and report to Eugene Silberpod.

Right, so it was Soldina who sent you. She remembers I owe her. So, what do you need?

Get into Feint’s base? Where’s that, Old Lighthouse? Jolly Roger bay? Are you out of your mind?

I’m coming with you. The only problem is the ship. Mine’s too old and battered, and yours is too Imperial, we’ll be shot on sight. We need a real pirate ship. I’ve seen one near here, called Astral Cuttlefish - we’re going to capture it.

Listen. You go forward, to the deck, and capture the control room. We are going to jump into the engine room to prevent them from exploding the reactor. Join us as soon as you’ve finished.
It’s been a long time since I did it.
Ugh, that was hard. Damned goblin nearly blew up the reactor, with us all together! But it’s okay, now we have a ship that significantly differs from those of the League and the Empire!
Capture the pirate ship, docked to the South of Takalik Harbor and report to Eugene Silberpod.

Right, so it was Naimitov who sent you. He remembers I owe him. So, what do you need?

Get into Feint’s base? Where’s that, Old Lighthouse? Jolly Roger bay? Are you out of your mind?

I’m coming with you. The only problem is the ship. Mine’s too old and battered, and yours is too Imperial, we’ll be shot on sight. We need a real pirate ship. I’ve seen one near here, called Astral Cuttlefish - we’re going to capture it.

Listen. You go forward, to the deck, and capture the control room. We are going to jump into the engine room to prevent them from exploding the reactor. Join us as soon as you’ve finished.
It’s been a long time since I did it.
Ugh, that was hard. Damned goblin nearly blew up the reactor, with us all together! But it’s okay, now we have a ship that significantly differs from those of the League and the Empire!
Comrade! I have an urgent errand for you. Great Yasker himself is ordering you to arrive to the Tower immediately. Immediately!
Greetings. You’re right on time, I have an important information for you. This is classified. Listen carefully.
Hello there. I have a message for you. Aidenus is gathering all League heroes together, and he’s got an urgent request to you, personally. Make sure to arrive to him right away.
Greetings. I am sorry about the fuss, but I have important information for you.
Collect information concerning "temporal anomaly" in the ruins of Skrakan’s tower at the bottom of the lake and from people in Upper City.

Curious. Letters are barely readable, and the terminology is not clear, but basically, it says about some kind of "temporary anomaly" created by Skrakan. But no further details whatsoever. It’s only clear that Skrakan held his experiments in a ritual hall under the ancient tower in a lake near Upper city.

You ought to examine the ruins closely. You might find something that will tell you more about the experiment, and reveal the way to fight the Leper.
I’ve never seen you before! Is it clear?
I never took a thing! I’ve been framed! I’m innocent!

An ancient note tells you that Skrakan used to study experiments with the time flow, which nobody had done before. You should search more evidence in the secret places of Skytower. There might be a temporal anomaly far from Umoir; now there's an allod occupied by the Empire. You'll have to find an Imperial soldier to help you sneak inside - talk to the guards, they will introduce you to Urri Miloslavin, who's currently in prison.
Find out what Miloslavin’s fault is, and meet the robbed trader.
Hey, psst, you’re a hero, right? Brave deeds, heroic exploits, all this stuff, right? Listen, I’m innocent as a child, won’t you save me? Please? Or they’ll chop my arms off! I beg you!
Are you from the investigation department? Not again...
I was robbed! And I know for sure it was Miloslavin! He alone knew I was going to my sweetheart exactly at this hour!
Buy 3 golden boxes from Jade Gloom and obtain 3 bear furs in the forest near Lower City, then return to Danil Nievert.

Everything, everything was stolen! All my life was invested in these things! A golden box... I mean, three boxes! And a bear fur coat! I mean, three bear fur coats!

Miloslavin is the thief, I’m telling you! He sold them, and spent money on booze, that’s right! Nothing was found on him, nothing, hear me?

Bring me back my golden box and the fur coat! I mean, of course, three boxes and three fur coats! I’ll lift my accusation then.
Have you got my stuff yet?

Three different boxed, eh? All right, they’ll do, now show me the furs...

What’s this? Fur? It’s a thin hide! Where are the furs?
Tell Urri Miloslavin that he’s free.

What? You’ll rip my skin off so that I could tell the difference? Are you crazy or something?

I’m kidding, just kidding! The furs are mine, all three of them.

Go to the guards and tell them I made a mistake, Miloslavin is innocent. Let them set him free. I found what was missing.

I was about to say goodbye to my arms! And that guard was staring at me, as if estimating, which one to start with.

So, what do you want? You didn’t do that just for the sake of it, right?
Go to classified facility Gates-II together with Miloslavin.

So, you want to enter a secret site and request my assistance? That’s smart! I’m a xadaganian, who else could help you?

Your Queen is quite canny, you see. She negotiates with the League and with the Empire. She agreed to allow to set up a scientific expedition at one of the allods. A secret object called "Gates II". I have no idea where the Gates One is. What they are studying there, I don’t know, either. I worked as a librarian at the Gates II, before I was accused of stealing one thing, so I had to flee as fast as I could. Then I was saved by some Umoir warriors, lucky me!

I can’t enter Empire, but I’ll do what I’m able to. I wonder if anything else can be fetched from the site...
I’ve seen a lot in my life, but never could even imagine any such thing...
The past, the future, my head is dizzy. To hell with such adventures.
Visit Nomarkh Iblis’ allod "Death Plant" to save Yelisseus.

Noone listening to us? Let me whisper in your ear... I’m afraid my Yelisseus got tangled with the bad guys, Light forbid, with the trade dealers, what do you call them, obligares, right. And the undead! Just think of it, he went to talk to an Iblis - is that a human name at all? Iblis in the Death Plant, Light save us. I’m scared. Please, see if my boy is alive, check upon that Iblis! I’ll be praying for you day and night!
You have found Yelisseus’ tracks? What are you waiting for?

Not so bad. Yelisseus was in such a hurry, he didn't even have time to change into a clean shirt. I hope you didn't have to really dig him from under ground? No kidding, where was he?

Death Plant, Nomarkh Iblis, you say? And there is my signature under the paper? Isn’t it a bit too much, eh? Hand me the letter, I’ll tell you a story.

Curious documents! It looks like Iblis broke our agreement and concealed the results! Bastard! I hope he suffered before death. Money I paid him was enough to build a whole fleet!

Don’t be so surprised. The great sorceress has business with some crazy Arisen. When it comes down to my project, I’m ready to get tangled with anyone, even the likes of you!

Engineers with their manatrons, the flying tower, the best shipyard in the world and my mechanical army - this all haven’t appeared out of the blue. It has taken years of hard work, failure and success. I am ready to work even with the walking dead, only to break through!

the future belongs to technology! Magic offers nothing new, see, during the last thousand years they invented next to nothing! the Arisen are aware that the progress cannot be stopped! I will head the new Conclave some day!

Never you mind all of it. the Ritual of the Veil awaits!
Get ready. Let’s start with someone simple, like Midnight Dweller, for example.
That didn’t even make you sweat! Alright, let’s try something more complicated.
Here you go, don’t lose it next time.

A source of incredible magical power, hm? Well, those Aoidoi aren’t as foolish as I thought, if they decided to hand it over to someone more experienced. Tell them I’ll be there on time.

No go, I’m very busy.

Where did you get it?! Give it to me now, I must... Oh, sorry! I'm still a little bit out of my head after that Leper disaster...

Yes, I know something about this crystal. Long ago, I saw a shard like this one. It was tiny. The man who gave it to me told me that he had found it in a wrecked ship, full with withered bodies of Zem. I suppose those were Tep cultists - those Arisen who believe in the Light would have resurrected.

My research showed that the stone was emitting an unknown energy of such an enormous power that it subjugated and altered all other known magical fields. I was trying to figure it out for a very long time and could find no proper use for it, so I decided to implement it in one of my mechanisms as an element of the stand-by energy contour. That device was left on Eclipse... Oh, no, you destroyed it in the fight with my faithful captain Krivov!
What has brought you to my chamber? Don't waste my time!
Visit Copper Mountain allod together with Envie Nickel to obtain Prophetic Ruby.

The prophetic ruby, you say? This is a very rare and dear gem. It is not often found in mines, you know. May be, Copper mountain was the last place in the universe! You don’t throw such things around. But if you really need one, I’ll help you - provided that you help me. Scratch my back, I’ll scratch yours! I grasped this principle long ago - unlike my brother.

You’re strong and brave, as I can see. I need heroes like you. There are evil spirits in Copper mountain mine. The work stopped, miners are scared, no gems, no income. Let’s go there and find out what happened. If you help me clear the mine, I’ll give you the ruby. Deal?
Copper mountain doesn't belong to me any longer. Talk to Nickel, he's the big man, all decisions were his, he's to face the consequences.

So this is how it all turns out... My brother loved gems and gold, and was turned into stone. I don’t blame the Mistress - she’s strict, but just. I am sorry about Nickel, though. He was my brother, after all.

Thank you for returning the bill. I’m smart now, and won’t let anyone bring harm to the mountain. Keep the Ruby like the apple of your eye!
Together with the representative of the Church of the Light, find the source of godly power in the Astral and return to Catherina.

So these are the gifts from local, so to say, gods? Looks like they’re really scared... Good! The power is not in belief, the power is in magic and knowledge! Only Light gives power, only Light is worth believing in! What have they done for their people? Nothing! They are bound to disappear now.

They said something that interested me, though. Spellweaving in the Astral then, hmm... My scanners registered a weird peak lately, of which I thought that it was one of the numerous Astral anomalies. Now I don’t think this happened just randomly.

This peak took place in our sector. I put down the coordinates. I think you should go there and see what happened. I will send you my confidante with you, she knows a thing or two about magic.
Have you brought good news or bad news?

What? Come again? My ears are failing! Folks out of nowhere, Klavdia escaped, mad Servant of Light... Are you out of your mind? Where's Claire? She's back at the allod trying to enforce the Light? I gave no such order!

You have also failed to find the roots of the Leper. Klavdia is not strong enough to start something like this. Servant of Light has nothing to do with it, either. Who's done that?..
Teleport to the docks and defeat the guard. Discuss further actions with Klavdia Kalugina.

How could I make such mistake...

It’s not the time to give up yet!

"Eclipse" is a huge ship, but it’s not too fast. I don’t think I can open a random portal for it to enter, so we have to catch it up. I’m sure we can find a decent boat for it.
Wow, these knights are so powerful! And I never thought golems were capable of using magic! Catherina has advanced so much, I wish she were on our side.
Board Dawn, order to start the chase and defeat attacking demons.

The gap between Eclipse and us is increasing every second! Let’s not waste time!

I wish I could go with you. Great mage escaped, and the local gods cannot go to the Astral, because they are part of this world. I’m the only one who can protect this allod until you come back. And if you don’t... Umoir is doomed. The fate of this world is really in your hands.

However, I cannot let you go on your own. See this coin? It’s got the League national emblem on one side, and Imperial one the other. Remember, what I told you about faith? Faith is power. People believe in their factions more than anything else! This very faith will come to your aid.

Find a mighty source of power - it may be a ship reactor, for instance - and drop this coin there. The help will arrive immediately.

Enough with the talks! Hurry to the ship!
I could never think Catherina will turn out to be so double faced! Now it’s time to pay for my own blindness. I an the only one who can drive Dawn through all anomalies and catch upon Eclipse!
What a monster! But we made it real quick, right? Let’s not waste time now.
Destroy Eclipse shields and use the boarding bridge to get to Eclipse.

See, there’s Eclipse ahead! It will be a good fight!

First, we’ll have to break through the shields of Eclipse. Before we do, the traitor’s ship is totally invulnerable. Then we’ll be able to throw bridges across and get to the deck of Eclipse - pray that noone falls into the Astral! Don’t even think of jumping over, Eclipse’s protection devices will kill you at an instant. Only across the bridges, no other way!

All ready? Board them!

I’ve never been so scared in my life! But we did it! We broke through!

"Eclipse" is a way too large for us to be able to split the assault team. We have to decide how we are going to make way to the control room. There are two paths: via upper deck, full of Catherina’s servants, or via cargo hold, where we’ll have to destroy the reactor. Without it, the "Eclipse" will be of no danger, and then we’ll deal with Catherina. It’s up to you to choose the way!
Get to the upper deck, defeat captain Krivov and his combat devices.

So, the upper deck. That’s a good decision. More space, easier to fight. However, we will be clearly seen, and there are plenty of Catherina’s servants. Most of all, I’m scared of captain Krivov. He’s widely known for his brutality.

I heard Catherina armed him with a weapon, never seen before. So beware of him!
What are you waiting for! Go ahead, board it! Let’s throw them all into the Astral!

It looks like a mysterious power captured the control over Ignat Krivov’s combat machine and turned it into a weird device. You haven’t come across any such thing before.

I guess, its logic became totally different, more... logical, so to say. What came out of it, was perfect, accomplished, purposeful... as if it has come from without of Sarnaut.

Whatever it was, it is dead. And we have to go on!
Kill the herdsman and free dragons from Eclipse, then use the released energy to activate Klavdia’s coin.

Very little has left, there are power shilds ahead, that cover... what is it? Dragons?!

What are they doing here, at Eclipse? Are they the "keys" to the seals that are to destroy Sarnaut? If it is so, they have to be deactivated.

What is... Who are you?

I have seen your face! I saw you during this short instant, when victory over Tep returned me from the non-being! And then I died again. Do you understand? I’m dead! Dead forever! I perished during the Great Astral Campaign, my body remained at the small island near the June Gates, and then it also disappeared in the Astral!

But still, I am right here talking to you. Is this real? Or just another last spark of life?

I am feeling alive! I’m full of power, it’s boiling inside me, I feel so strong! How did you do this? And... why?
Defeat mender goblins in cargo hold.

Cargo hold! That’s a good idea! A perfect place to corner the assaulters!

We should only be aware of the three goblin mechanics down there. They’re real animals, able of biting an iron wrench into halves! And they know their compartment in and out! Be careful!
Tell me now, what do you want?
Ugh, ugh... We’re easy to hurt, yeah... But you’re dead anyway!
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Don't chat too much. We don't have time.
You're more stubborn than I'd thought.
Destroy Eclipse reactor and use the released energy to activate Klavdia’s coin.

The reactor will burn you to ashes, fools! Do you really think that the Queen needs Firebird to cure the Leper? In your dreams! It’s pure and unlimited energy for free! You still wanna break down the reactor? There it is, down the corridor, go on.

Are you playing chicken now? You’re done with, so that you knew, the reactor’s got a demonic soul in it! Ugh... Ugh... I’m dying...

The demon will eat you, for sure. If not the demon, then the heat will burn you... and I’m going to be resurrected by the Queen for my loyalty and service...

I thought ghosts cannot feel a thing... But I am feeling heat and pain. Am I alive?

Oh wait, I remember you! You released my spirit from under Tep’s power, and I told you the truth about the cataclysm!

So now I am alive, that’s weird. I have to be dead, you know. The mistake that I made took away so many lives. They’re dead, and I’m alive now... It hurts. Why have you brought me back? I’m such a loser!

There was a battle here! I’ll have to ask my questions later, then. I guess someone really powerful helped you resurrect me, that means I owe them my life! It's the debt to pay, like the Empire always does. Now tell me, why do you need my help?

...

I see. So this fool decided to break the seal. I cannot believe it. Catherina is not smart, but she won’t kill herself. I cannot believe she’s able to serve anybody, either. She’s too proud and loves power. It’s more like it, that something has captured her will, and she doesn’t know what she’s doing.

If we kill a great mage near the seal, the huge blast of energy will release and break the seal. This outcome is quite predictable - and foreseen by the enemy, I am sure. It means, we mustn’t kill Catherina.

Let’s go now. We will have more time to think!

I'm... I'm free! Damn you, Sarn! Curse...

I guess you're waiting for the words of regret? Alright, you may tell them all, Yasker, Aidenus, whoever you're reporting to... Tell them I admit I acted like a fool!

No great mage can create life out of nothingness. It must be a god. Tell me more before I fall into ashes again, quick.

...

Oh, Catherina, Catherina... Your pride will ruin you one day. Although I do not believe she could make this decision on her own. Breaking the seal! This is incredible! Nobody can survive it, and Catherina is surely not suicidal. She’s rather weak, though, so I’m sure there is someone behind her back.

You mustn’t kill her! Don’t even fancy this! Killing a great mage near the Seal will break it for sure, and this will bring us all to an end! We need to neutralize her somehow, before she does something beyond recall.

Enough with the reflections. We have to stop her. That’s the way to go.

Damn...

I guess you're waiting for the words of regret? Alright, you may tell them all, Yasker, Aidenus, whoever you're reporting to... Tell them I admit I acted like a fool!
Listen to what Catherina has to say and talk to Yasker in Nezebgrad.

It's not a good time for being unreasonably angry.

Now that all his plans have failed, he has nothing better to do but to destroy the Seal and kill us all. My death may release energy, high enough to crack the Seal...

Your help is needed to send Sarn back into the dark. Let's go, talk to you later... after the battle.
Here you are. I've been expecting you.

I can feel something really important happened far away in the Astral. Cannot tell you, how I knew it. I just sense it.

I can also see that I shouldn't worry too much. I think I can congratulate you on the successful mission completion. No report needed, either.

However, I'm asking you to tell me what happened...
Listen to what Catherina has to say and talk to Aidenus in Novograd.

It's not a good time for being unreasonably angry.

Now that all his plans have failed, he has nothing better to do but to destroy the Seal and kill us all. My death may release energy, high enough to crack the Seal...

Your help is needed to send Sarn back into the dark. Let's go, talk to you later... after the battle.
Here you are. I've been expecting you.

I've been waiting for you to return. I had a feeling that something awful was about to happen... But you are here, and everything's all right. We should thank you for saving it all again... and for the new details, too.

I'm glad to see you safe and sound. Tell me, what exactly happened. We have a lot to think of.
Ask Tale Teller about the trinket
What? What amulet? I’m a tale teller, not some unholy outcast! That’s not a question to ask to me! Go to Grooden and demand him!
Do you like my story, friend?

You’ve found Warrior’s trinket, and the others should be near.

Everyone bows to the Warrior, no matter what they do - go to war or return home alive. Bow to the Warrior, and no sword will cut you, no bolt will hit you. The battle evens everyone, whether you’re a bandit or a hero, you’ve got your own fate. When you come to your end, the Warrior will meet you on the other side to invite you to the feast in his parlor, where the beautiful young ladies dance, and brave heroes fight in the eternity.

Come by again some day, I will tell you more.
Take the drill to Tale Teller in Lower City.
The amulet looks elegant and fine, regardless of its old age. It depicts animals among tree branches, and it seems to smell like blood and fir needles. You should ask Tale Teller about it.
What have you got, friend? An old amulet? Listen to my story then...

Hunter was considered the smartest and deftest of the gods. All animals of the woods, birds of the sky and the never-seen creatures obeyed him alone, born by his word and died by his will. He knew all: whether the hunt will be successful or not, or the arrow will hit the aim, or a branch crunches under a hunter's foot. He accepted blood, wild honey and berries for sacrifices.

In the years of poor harvest, a huge bear came. It killed cattle and destroyed crops. Whoever turned out to be brave enough to face and fight it, soon found out that it was noone else, but the Hunter turned into the bear. Hunter and the brave one became sworn brothers then, and all the luck and success was on his side forever.

Hunter is strict. He cannot stand cowardice and laziness. He aids the brave and the skilled. After death, they will stand together with other brave hunters, blowing a hunting horn and riding the trotters in high heavens.

Come by, if you find more artifacts. I will tell you other stories...
Meet Tale Teller in Lower City’s tavern.

That’s a strange image. Faded colors, scratches, and a very sad girl’s face... But her eyes are so... luring. Their look has tenderness, sadness, love, and desperation. No doubt, a great master created it.

You should ask Tale Teller who is depicted here.
Greetings, friend! What news do you bring me?

You were lucky to obtain the trinket of the Maiden! It’s not as simple as it looks. She put all her soul into it, her kindness and care. She always takes care of every being, of people and animals, stones and plants. She can reveal herself in either of the three appearences: a young girl, a caring mother or a wise old woman. She guards our families and protects us from evil. That is why we love and respect her.
Obtain the Pagan amulet from Grooden Dubin and bring it to Tale Teller.

So you want to listen to the ancient gods’ will? Of course, they had no templars - they simply didn’t need them. They came willingly to the decent ones, and would never speak to the unworthy!

You have got three signs - the Maiden’s image, the Hunter’s drill and the Warrior’s charm. These things are not simple, a common man cannot get hold of them. Now you need to find the last one. I heard a rumour that Grooden escaped the Ring and took one thing with him. My guess is that the thing is what you are looking for.

There are four gods above us, mortals. It's Warrior, and Hunter, and Master, and Maiden. They give us protection and bestow us power. There is Sage above them all, who never interferes into mortals' deeds. His advice is priceless.

I made no mistake. Here it is, Master's Amulet! Only the skilled ones can get it. Grooden had been like that before he betrayed his fathers' faith for the Light.

But wait. You say Grooden called upon the Leper in combat, and the Leper responded? That is most unusual.

I used to believe that the Leper had been sent down by the Gods as a punishment, but now you say there is someone who is able to take control over it and use the power... Besides, Grooden is a simple local man, not that weak but not that strong, either... nothing special.

Relics of ancient faith keep quiet. I hoped so that they would show us the way, but alas.

Whether I want it or not, I'll have to tell you one secret. There is someone who can tell you a lot about the essence of the Leper...
Find the strongbox hidden at the bottom of the lake near Covert Hide and bring it to Swarog.

Good man! Listen to an old man’s plea! I heard about your brave deeds and your heart’s kindness. I know even our gods favor you! If it’s true, it’ll be easy for you to help me.

Swarog is my name, I’ve lived here all my life. I managed to scratch and scrape a little bit of money and gems, to leave to my grandkids after I die. I put this small treasure into a chest, and hid it in a lake that’s near here. Now there’s a monster in the lake that won’t let anyone approach!

Help the old man, bring back my chest!

Oh, this is so good, such good news! Here’s my dear chest!

Thank you, you are so kind! Please, take this ring as a reward! It’s not so pretty, but it will serve you well, believe me!
Go to the shrine in Covert Hide and touch one of its idols.
I’ll tell you something. You’re a good hero, very noble and respectful. Go to our sacred shrine, touch the idols. They may show you something you will be interested in...
It’s strange, these five idols look really old, as if they spent hundrends of years here, and this one looks brand new. Even its wood has not yet darkened.
Ask Luka Artful at Pagan Shrine in Covert Hide about Peregrina's idol, then bring the requested sacrifice.

That’s weird. There are only five gods in Umoir - Sage, Warrior, Hunter, Master and Maiden. What is the sixth statue?..

You should ask someone about it.
I never expected to see you here. Are you joining my followers?
Easy, you’re not going to try and strangle me, eh? I’m not there right now, this is just a hologram. Why are you so mad, anyways? Are you sorry about the Spark? You say, it was Tep’s Spark? Big deal.
Bring back the stolen sword, armor, cup and toy to Lovvie Goodman in Upper City

Thieves got into the house the other day looking to steal money. They didn’t find the money, so they took whatever random things they could find: a straw doll - old Yelisseus’ toy, and his silver cup, and an old battered armor, and his sharp blade. That’s rubbish for them, but I cherished these things as a memory... I wish I could return them...

Cup is likely to have been sold. Jade is greedy about such things, check with him. Sword... it could only be good for some beggar, who's got no money for a new weapon. Armor could have been sold to a blacksmith for remelting - iron is expensive nowadays. As to the toy... it could tempt but a baby. A normal thief would have thrown it away, and I have no idea as to where to find it.

You are such a good one! I never expected my dear things to come back!
You have no evil in mind, as I can see. Very well then, I will tell you about my darling Yelisseus - who knows, may be you'll be lucky to find him...
Find all five kittens and bring them back to Mila Kittenson.

A toy? What toy? This one? My kittens found it somewhere in the street, and played with it all day. And then they got bored and ran off. How do I gather them now? What if someone hurts them? They’re little kids!

You know what, you help me find them, and meanwhile, I will fix and clean your toy.
My dear kittens! I've been missing you so!

Yuppie, they’re back, all five of them! Fluffy, Snoozie, Whiskers, Grumpie and Mr.Quaxo Mooncustripe himself! Why Mooncustripe? He loves the moon and never sleeps at night!

Here’s your doll, good as new!
Talk to Bean Bold and play Heads or Tails with him.
What’cha lookin’ at? M’sword? If I had a coin every time someone stares at it, I’d be rich! Huh huh. I wish! I’m flat broke, dude. Was lucky to grab the sword from some vagabond!
Ask Ivan Drunker, Arseniy Krymov and Barbara Brie to return their debts and bring them to Jade Gloom in Upper City.

The silver cup? I have one. Why would you care?
Give back the cup? No way. Pay or get out.
Do you really really want it? That’s good. I’ve got a task for you. Some people owe me gold: Ivan Drunker, Arseniy Krymov and Barbara Brie. Bring me back my gold, I will give you the cup. For free, all right.

You managed to shake out the debt out of all three? Nice!
Here’s to you, if you really want it!
Retrieve 20 Iron links from birds around Lower City and bring them back to blacksmith Dandy Joll.

I knew it wasn’t so simple!

A man knocked on my door one night and offered an armor for sale. That armor was so old and battered, I didn’t want to buy. So he threw it over the fence to my garden, turned around and walked away. I picked it up the next morning, of course, why would it just lay there?

A few chainrings were missing - I guess, magpies could steal them. Find them and bring back to me, I’ll help you fix it.
About twenty links are missing from this armor...

This armor is really old. I tried my best and fixed it, but I'm no god, you know. 'S all I could do, see? One good blow, and it'll shread away. Here, if you really want it, there's nothing else I can do about it. I have some decent ones for sale, though!
Return to Umoir and report about Zayan’s words

Whatever happened - happened. I believe in destiny. There is no point in blaming and cursing yourself for the mistakes. No need to be sorry about the past. The present is more important.

I wish I could help you. But I don’t think Catherina will welcome her enemy at Umoir. Besides, Avilon cannot stay without its great mage even for a while. You will have to fight alone!
Where the hell have you been? I don’t care, in fact. Do you remember about our agreement? Don’t waste time then!

Is that so? Interesting...

Of course, I’ll be there. So I could at least make sure this power doesn’t end up in the wrong hands.
Take this and don't lose it again!
h: Ask for another beacon to return to the Citadel

t: Remember that mysterious amulet that I obtained after you returned from the captivity of illusions? I found out who it had belonged to. Long ago on Howlem, the distant land of Pridens, lived a tribe that Pridens called the Shoom Branch. One of Priden shamans - a doolga - told me that the Shoom Branch fell under the influence of Tep Cultists and was involved in one of his resurrection attempts, but eventually was obliterated by other Branches. It happened soon after the Shoom leader had discovered an ancient Portal that led to an allod unknown to Astralonauts. Pridens call it Ferris.
h: Ask what Zayan has found out

t: Greetings! It's been a long time since our last meeting... And many new riddles of the past have come about!

Wait, you fool, or do you have a death wish?

I’ve got something important to tell you! Listen. The old witch has stuck sticks with skulls on them all around her house. They will burn you with magic fire, just as soon as you approach them. Here’s an amulet to protect you against the skulls. And may Tensess help you!
Hold on, my love! I’m coming!
House de Tristesse is revenged! Now hurry to my beloved Annette!
Search for the Seven Knights’ house and find out what happened to Annette.
Here, she writes that she made up her mind to escape and head to the forest, to the Seven Knights. What knights? Let’s find them.
Why haven’t you come earlier, Yelisseus...
That saved me the explanation. Have you seen the witch? It was her who took Annette’s father to the grave, and then the whole House, too.
